evidence_summary: Effects Database explicitly catalogs a Nomad Tone Booster as Nomad by UMI. This supports a UMI relationship for the Tone Booster state but does not establish the wider Nomad brand as UMI-controlled or UMI-built.

Tone Machines identifies Nomad Banshee Fuzz as one of the Nomad versions of the Banshee Fuzz and explains that Nomad functioned as a house brand for LIMMCO. The same research places the Banshee production on the Applied Audio branch, while exact manufacturing dates remain unknown.

physical_builder_candidate: LIMMCO / Long Island Musical Merchandise Co.
evidence_summary: Tone Machines identifies Nomad as a house brand of LIMMCO, a major Long Island wholesaler/distributor. This is a brand-ownership/distribution clue and must not be converted into a blanket physical-builder assignment.

status: The UMI-linked Nomad Tone Booster and the Applied Audio-linked Nomad Banshee Fuzz are separate product states. Because Nomad was used as a LIMMCO house brand, the archive must not treat the Nomad name itself as evidence of a single factory.
